snippet.title: Redcrest: 1993 DEMO | Out Now!
snippet.description:
The demo of my latest story-centered horror game, Redcrest: 1993, is now available on Steam and Itch.io!

Thank you to all those who have helped me through this process!

STEAM PAGE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3477320/Redcrest_1993/

ITCH.IO PAGE: 
https://the-dev-kid.itch.io/redcrest-1993
